description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'GrantTypeNotAllowedForClient' within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API exception namespace. The class extends a base OAuth2 exception class and is used to indicate that a specific grant type is not permitted for a client.

classes.name: GrantTypeNotAllowedForClient
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a particular OAuth2 grant type is not allowed for a client.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the exception with a message, code, and previous exception. It prepends a specific label to the message.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string detailing that the grant type is not allowed for the client.
